title: OpenAI: handle RequiresMistralToolIDs compat flag
description: The ModelCompat flag RequiresMistralToolIDs is defined but not handled in the OpenAI provider. When this flag is set, tool call IDs need Mistral-compatible formatting. Add the handling in the OpenAI request builder.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: R1 review complete — Approved. 1 P3 finding (cosmetic: hex-only IDs vs full alphanumeric). No changes needed. See docs/reviews/aiag-b9b-r1-review-reviewer-sea.md
